diagnosedIssues: Type compatibility for Readable/DNS/csv-parse and PDF.js 6 removed options corrected against installed versions.
Control-character regex lint finding corrected with an equivalent explicit character check; no rule suppression.
Initial 250-test run had 1 failure: chunk input end beyond text length was not rejected. Added full block/text/span invariant; regression retained.
JSON arrays now preserve numeric source order; added >10-item regression.
Final cold install and 263-test run plus 4 browser cases all pass.
limits: No upload/persistent task/index/query pipeline until S05 onward.
No G01-G12 algorithm/reference acceptance or real external model validation.
V8 worker heap is not OS RSS/native memory or hostile-code execution sandbox; no exhaustive malformed PDF/Office or production stress claim.
No OCR/encrypted parsing/formula or macro execution/exact layout; see capability matrix.
CFB encryption check is a signature probe; macros fixture is inert synthetic payload, not real VBA compatibility testing.
UTF-8 text/OOXML parts, approximate PDF order, raw XLSX number/date values; full variants outside tested scope.
